native_row.source_origin_resource_id_basis: provider catalog geometry reference, not a simulated pick/origin identifier
native_row.source_simulation_origin_time_basis: truth t=0; initial/inverted t is a simulated correction in seconds
native_row.receiver_identifier_basis: derived from provider SEED codes using FDSN Source Identifiers v1.0
native_row.receiver_vertical_datum_basis: NCEDC documents station elevations and catalog geoid depth on the same datum; StationXML supplies no explicit vertical-datum field
native_row.receiver_elevation_semantics: Channel/Elevation interpreted as sensor elevation per StationXML; no separate burial correction
native_row.receiver_metadata_epoch_basis: Intersection of provider StationXML network, station and channel epochs

original_reference.certificate_basis: Exact rational coefficients from binary64 inputs; outward interval arithmetic and exact rational special cases
original_reference.time_ordering: Ordinary floating-point action evaluation; branch count is certified, but no interval bound on minimum-time ordering is claimed

diagnostic_variant_reference.certificate_basis: Exact rational coefficients from binary64 inputs; outward interval arithmetic and exact rational special cases
diagnostic_variant_reference.time_ordering: Ordinary floating-point action evaluation; branch count is certified, but no interval bound on minimum-time ordering is claimed
